[[File:Stasis_Field_SWGTCG.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] using a portable shield generator during a battle.]]
'''Portable shield generators''' or '''portable energy shields'''<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> were movable [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. They were traditionally deployed to protect [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-side weapons emplacements and bases.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> The [[Rampart II Shield Generator|Rampart II]] manufactured by [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] was a portable shield generator.<ref name="RE">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Rogue Elements|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref>
